# Desktop app icon sources

These app marks identify the supported desktop applications. They are not the Hatrack product logo and are not original MIT-licensed Hatrack artwork.

- `claude-mark.png`: Claude mark supplied by the project owner, from the image requested in this task. The supplied PNG has a transparent background; its alpha silhouette is used without reshaping it.
- `codex-mark.png`: unplated desktop app icon from the installed official OpenAI.Codex Windows package, version 26.930.2377.0, asset `Square44x44Logo.targetsize-256_altform-unplated.png`. Its alpha silhouette is used without reshaping it.

Anthropic and OpenAI retain rights to their respective marks. Recolouring is a local profile customization feature. Hatrack is independently developed and is not endorsed by either vendor. Uploaded artwork belongs to its owner.
